(1) the cloud computing paradigm can be deployed to enable smart cities, (2) there is an urgent need to develop a smart city as a service (SCaaS) roadmap for e-government cloud computing initiatives, (3) there are a number of key challenges that need to be addressed to enable the development and deployment of a future SCaaS roadmap, and (4) the development of such a roadmap should be undertaken as a collaborative international initiative.
the smart city concept has the potential to be the crucible of technological innovation, and that cloud computing is a vehicle for catalysing the development of smart city innovation.
cloud computing is an emerging paradigm that is being increasingly adopted in the public sector.

exploring the potential of cloud computing as a vehicle to facilitate the development of smart city e-government services.
the identification and analysis of cloud computing as a strategic enabler of smart city innovation and as a vehicle for the realization of a global smart city.
exploring the role of cloud computing in the realization of the smart city vision.

cloud computing is an enabler of smart cities and that cloud computing can be used in a smart city to enable the delivery of services to the citizens.
the smart city as a service is a concept whose time has come.
smart cities can be enabled by cloud computing and that the cloud computing paradigm is a strategic direction for the development of e-government smart cities.

cloud computing can be leveraged as a strategic tool for realizing the vision of a smart city.

the cloud is a key enabler of a future smart city.
